scope: Exact attribution conditional on each explicitly declared 2×2×2 finite law; the law is not the original fitted city posterior, and block results are not a population interval.
selection: Chronological V13 bank index i in 0,2,4,6. Rest draws i and i+1, first two A and B draws of V13 bank i. No selection by policy values.
probabilities: Rest/A/B each uniform on two separately indexed atoms. Resampling uses independent size-four multinomial draws with replacement for A/B, conditional on a single uniformly drawn revealed rest atom.
attribution: A=J−V*, B=V*−V_R, C=V_R−V_Rτ, D=V_Rτ−E[Z_4×4]. Full causal solves stop only at the journey terminal, and τ uses original V13 first ride or 720s.
